Title: Grasshoppers
Content: A student wants to know if the traits of the grass plants eaten by the grasshoppers are affected by the environment. The student sets up an investigation to collect data using the procedure shown.

:ibox:`bbtext(Investigation Procedure)`

`1`. Fill `text(two)` containers with `300` `text(grams)` of soil in each.
`2`. Place a grass plant into `text(each container)`.
`3`. Set the containers near a window.
`4`. Measure the height of `text(each grass plant)` on `text(day)` `1`.
`5`. Count the number of leaves on `text(each grass plant)` on `text(day)` `1`.
`6`. Water the grass plants every `5` `text(days)`.
`7`. Measure the height of `text(each grass plant)` on `text(day)` `15`.
`8`. Count the number of leaves on `text(each grass plant)` on `text(day)` `15`.
